name: asset-import-navigator
description: Navigate imported SVG, CSS, SCSS, CSS Modules, and other assets to their real source files, with useful hover previews instead of declaration-file dead ends.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace values of assetImportNavigator.aliases are ignored so an untrusted folder cannot point resolution or hover previews outside itself. Everything else works; no project code is executed.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Asset navigation resolves files on the local or remote file system (file: scheme); virtual workspaces such as github.dev are not supported.

assetImportNavigator.enabled.description: Enable Mode A definition rewrite and Mode B document links / fallback definition for supported asset imports.

assetImportNavigator.extensions.description: Asset file extensions eligible for navigation rewrite.

assetImportNavigator.aliases.description: Optional path-prefix aliases (values absolutized against the project directory). Prefer tsconfig paths when possible.

assetImportNavigator.queryPolicy.description: How import query strings are handled when resolving physical assets.

assetImportNavigator.debug.description: Write mode detection and resolution diagnostics to the Asset Import Navigator OutputChannel (never logs source file contents).

assetImportNavigator.hover.enabled.description: Show physical-asset hover content for supported asset imports.

assetImportNavigator.hover.svgPreview.description: Embed a sanitized local SVG thumbnail in hover when safe (markdown-image data URI).

assetImportNavigator.hover.maxPreviewByt.description: Maximum SVG file size in bytes for hover preview. Larger files fall back to metadata-only.
